import hashlib,json,os,shutil,signal,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM,lambda *args:(_ for _ in ()).throw(TimeoutError("independent integration verification exceeded 180 seconds"))); signal.alarm(180)
root=Path("/root/LCRSeg/runs/di_dmpa_gate1c_v22/9593908bd36f7f833e385a70b2b772b7a8c84d22/integration_attempt1")
def read(p): return json.loads(p.read_text())
def sha(p):
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    with p.open("rb") as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b""): h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()
manifest=root/"GATE1C_V2_ARTIFACT_MANIFEST.json"
m=read(manifest); rows=m["artifacts"]; names=[r["path"] for r in rows]
excluded={manifest.name,"GATE1C_V2_ARTIFACT_MANIFEST.sha256"}
assert sha(manifest)==(root/"GATE1C_V2_ARTIFACT_MANIFEST.sha256").read_text().split()[0]
actual=[p for p in root.rglob("*") if p.is_file()]
assert not any(p.is_symlink() for p in root.rglob("*"))
assert len(names)==len(set(names))==m["file_count"]
assert {str(p.relative_to(root)) for p in actual if p.name not in excluded}==set(names)
assert sum(r["bytes"] for r in rows)==m["total_bytes"]
for r in rows:
    p=root/r["path"]
    assert p.resolve().is_relative_to(root.resolve())
    assert p.stat().st_size==r["bytes"] and sha(p)==r["sha256"],str(p)
meta=read(root/"GATE1C_V2_RUN_METADATA.json"); status=read(root/"GATE1C_V22_STATUS.json"); done=read(root/"EXECUTION_COMPLETION.json")
assert meta["diagnostic_code_commit"]==meta["remote_verified_code_commit"]=="1cfd8235293e157afd6b40f0f091ce6bc6df9f9f"
assert meta["preregistration_commit"]=="9593908bd36f7f833e385a70b2b772b7a8c84d22" and meta["authorization_commit"]=="aabef38c473f281bef7717e77fa326a542266d76"
assert meta==status["metadata"]==done["metadata"]
assert status["status"]=="PASS_EXACT_CODE_REAL_INTEGRATION" and status["scientific_admission"] is None and not status["method_registered"]
assert status["counts"]==dict(native_forwards=51,shadow_forwards=24,native_autograd=276,shadow_autograd=366)
assert done["status"]=="COMPLETE" and done["controller_result_code"]==0
assert not (root/"STOP_REQUESTED.json").exists() and not list(root.glob("FAILURE_*.json"))
assert not Path("/proc") .joinpath(str(meta["controller_pid"])).exists(),"controller PID still exists; inspect"
phases={}
for phase in ("draw0","noise","posterior","poe"):
    r=read(root/f"PHASE_{phase}.json")
    assert r["metadata"]==meta and r["status"]=="PASS" and r["numerical_checks_complete"]
    for path,digest in r["evidence_sha256"].items(): assert sha(root/path)==digest
    exits=read(root/f"PROCESS_EXIT_{phase}.json")
    assert exits["exit_codes"]==[0,0]
    phases[phase]=dict(counts=r["counts"],totals=r["totals"],native_PAS_calls=r["native_PAS_calls"],worker_pids=exits["worker_pids"],exit_codes=exits["exit_codes"])
audit=read(root/"CACHE_REUSE_AUDIT.json")
assert audit["status"]=="PASS" and audit["cache_reuse_approved"] and audit["cases"]==495 and audit["pixels"]==72990720 and audit["cache_bytes"]==4856574421
assert audit["known_real_null"]["null"]==1 and audit["known_real_null"]["first_null_coordinates"]==[[185,180]]
refs=audit["references"]; assert len(refs)==len({r["path"] for r in refs})
for r in refs:
    p=Path(r["path"]); assert p.stat().st_size==r["bytes"] and sha(p)==r["sha256"],str(p)
assert read(root/"INPUT_REFERENCES_after.json")["status"]=="PASS"
guard=read(root/"GATE1C_V2_MODEL_IMMUTABILITY_AUDIT.json")
assert guard["new_probe_guard_count"]==12 and guard["reused_validation_guard_count"]==9 and guard["all_model_states_bitwise_unchanged"] and guard["all_grad_fields_None"]
numbers=read(root/"NUMERICAL_COMPARISON_AUDIT.json")
gpus=subprocess.check_output(["nvidia-smi","--query-gpu=index,uuid,name,memory.used,utilization.gpu","--format=csv,noheader"],text=True,timeout=10)
apps=subprocess.check_output(["nvidia-smi","--query-compute-apps=pid,process_name","--format=csv,noheader"],text=True,timeout=10)
procs=[]
for proc in Path("/proc").iterdir():
    if not proc.name.isdigit() or int(proc.name)==os.getpid(): continue
    try: argv=[x.decode(errors="replace") for x in (proc/"cmdline").read_bytes().split(b"\0") if x]
    except OSError: continue
    if "di_dmpa_gate1c_v2.runner" in argv: procs.append(dict(pid=int(proc.name),argv=argv))
assert not procs and not apps.strip()
retain=[r for r in refs if r["retain_private_copy"]]
print(json.dumps(dict(status="PASS_INDEPENDENT_INTEGRATION_ARTIFACT_AND_REFERENCE_VERIFICATION",observed_remote_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),output=str(root),code_commit=meta["diagnostic_code_commit"],controller_pid=meta["controller_pid"],controller_pid_absent=True,manifest_sha256=sha(manifest),manifest_indexed_files=m["file_count"],manifest_indexed_bytes=m["total_bytes"],physical_file_count=len(actual),physical_bytes=sum(p.stat().st_size for p in actual),integration_status=status["status"],counts=status["counts"],coverage=status["coverage"],phases=phases,new_probe_guards=12,reused_validation_guards=9,reference_files=len(refs),reference_bytes=sum(r["bytes"] for r in refs),retain_reference_files=len(retain),retain_reference_bytes=sum(r["bytes"] for r in retain),cache_reuse_approved=True,known_null=audit["known_real_null"],numerical_audit={k:v for k,v in numbers.items() if k!="metadata"},elapsed_seconds=done["elapsed_seconds"],gpus=gpus,compute_apps=apps,processes=procs,available_bytes=shutil.disk_usage("/root/LCRSeg").free,formal_output_exists=(root.parent/"attempt1").exists(),optimizer_updates=0),indent=2),flush=True)
